positive_unit: 1841 independent parent events; at most P7/P9/P11 per event; no cross-split derived views

negative_policy.grade_a_train_events: 15m candidate identities only, subject to source, render, temporal, exclusion and visible-label checks
negative_policy.other_timeframes: Require negatives with matching source, symbol, timeframe, time block and split; no fixed quota may weaken exclusion
negative_policy.hard_negative_target: Dense but no qualifying visible launch is a candidate under launch semantics; unresolved dense examples remain review-only
negative_policy.prohibited_label: Future SL, timeout or failure to reach3R does not by itself establish an empty morphology label

training_recipe.image_augmentation: All flips, color, mosaic, mixup and geometric transforms remain disabled; only the three deterministic OHLC crops differ
training_recipe.new_training_yaml: Create only after a complete audited positive-and-negative manifest is frozen

recognition_evaluation.fixed_reference: Original P9 val/test events; preserve image and label hashes
recognition_evaluation.position_robustness: Paired P7/P9/P11 results on the same val/test events; report event-level and per-position results without treating views as independent events
recognition_evaluation.padding_robustness: Repeat inherited native-padding and aligned-padding protocols; retain failures under either path, because v6A had a documented padding collapse
recognition_evaluation.negative_strata: Report clear-background and reviewed dense-no-launch false detections separately by timeframe; no unconditional false-positive claim from a selected case-control pool
recognition_evaluation.baseline: Re-evaluate the existing v6A checkpoint on identical frozen inputs and settings; historical Grade-A metrics from a different dataset are not a direct comparator
recognition_evaluation.continuous_replay: Keep raw boxes, causal event grouping and any separate semantic/strategy gates visible as distinct stages; never report raw boxes as executable signals

trading_evaluation: Recognition improvement is not trading success. Any later trading claim needs unchanged20bp cost, matched random controls and separate forward evidence.
